note: This directory is for orientation only and is not an endorsement; check each provider's regulation and suitability on the official registers before engaging them.

conveyancer.label: Property solicitor / conveyancer
conveyancer.why: Handles the legal transfer of each property, title checks, searches and mortgage paperwork into whichever owner you choose.

property_tax.label: Property tax adviser
property_tax.why: Works out SDLT, ATED, CGT and corporation tax for the chosen structure and confirms which surcharges and reliefs apply.

corporate.label: Company formation / corporate solicitor
corporate.why: Incorporates PropCo Ltd at Companies House with the right SIC code, articles, shareholders and registered office.

accountant.label: Company accountant
accountant.why: Prepares PropCo's annual accounts, corporation tax returns and Companies House filings.

fund_lawyer.label: Fund lawyer (Jersey / UK)
fund_lawyer.why: Drafts and structures the JPUT trust instrument or RIF documents and obtains the Jersey consents or meets the UK RIF conditions.

fund_admin.label: Fund administrator / trustee
fund_admin.why: Acts as the regulated JPUT trustee and administrator, or supports the RIF's operator and depositary, and runs investor records and fund accounts.

private_client.label: Trusts and inheritance tax solicitor
private_client.why: Drafts the discretionary trust deed, plans the IHT entry, ten-year and exit charges, and advises the settlor and trustees.

trustee.label: Trust company / professional trustee
trustee.why: Acts as or alongside the trustees who own PropCo's shares, keeps the trust compliant and handles HMRC Trust Registration Service filings.

registers.name: SRA Solicitors Register
registers.how: Search a solicitor or firm by name to confirm it is authorised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority in England and Wales.

registers.name: Law Society Find a Solicitor
registers.how: Search by area of law (e.g. residential conveyancing, trusts) and location to shortlist solicitor firms in England and Wales.

registers.name: CLC Find a CLC Lawyer
registers.how: Search by individual, practice or postcode to find or verify a licensed conveyancer regulated by the Council for Licensed Conveyancers.

registers.name: CIOT Find a Member (Chartered Tax Advisers)
registers.how: Check that an adviser is a Chartered Tax Adviser listed by the Chartered Institute of Taxation.

registers.name: ATT Find a Member
registers.how: Check that a tax practitioner is a member of the Association of Taxation Technicians.

registers.name: ICAEW Find a Chartered Accountant
registers.how: Use ICAEW's directory to find or verify ICAEW chartered accountancy firms by location and service.

registers.name: ACCA Find an Accountant
registers.how: Search ACCA's directory for ACCA-qualified accountancy practices near you and confirm their membership.

registers.name: Companies House: Find and update company information
registers.how: Look up any UK company, including a formation agent, accountancy firm or your own PropCo, to check its status, officers and filings.

registers.name: GOV.UK: Set up a limited company
registers.how: Official step-by-step guidance on incorporating PropCo Ltd, either directly with Companies House or through an agent.

registers.name: Law Society of Jersey Firm Search
registers.how: Search the Jersey Law Society's list of Jersey law firms to confirm a firm practises Jersey law.

registers.name: Jersey Finance Business Directory
registers.how: Filter by fund administration, trust and company administration or law to shortlist Jersey providers (industry directory, not a regulator).

registers.name: JFSC Regulated Entities
registers.how: Search a provider's name, filtering by 'Fund services' or 'Trust company', to confirm it is licensed by the Jersey Financial Services Commission.

registers.name: JFSC Registry entities search
registers.how: Search the Jersey company registry by name or number to check a Jersey trustee company or fund entity exists and is active.

registers.name: FCA Financial Services Register
registers.how: Check that a proposed RIF operator (UK AIFM) or depositary is authorised by the FCA and holds the right permissions.

registers.name: GFSC Fiduciary Regulated Entities
registers.how: Check that a Guernsey trust company holds a fiduciary licence from the Guernsey Financial Services Commission.

registers.name: HMRC: Register a trust as a trustee
registers.how: Official guidance on whether and when the family trust must register on HMRC's Trust Registration Service.

registers.name: HMRC: Manage your trust's registration
registers.how: Official guidance for trustees or their agent on keeping the Trust Registration Service record up to date and getting proof of registration.
